summary: A worker explains why unused time off does not mean they can take a vacation.
realLife: Snyder said she reserved paid time off in case her son or mother became ill, even when she wanted time for her own health or a family vacation.
gates: The worker reports reserving an actual leave balance for family care.
inGame: needs: the worker’s stated reason for saving a leave balance.

turns.what: The worker uses leave for their own appointment.
turns.pulledBy: Another benefit covers the family contingency.
